 Latest stat proves Brighton's stats as PL entertainers 💫 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article Brighton are on an absolute high early in the 2026/27 campaign following a flying start.
 Brighton & Hove Albion 2 Brentford 0 Today Full time The Seagulls had the chance to move up to second in the Premier League table ahead of Sunday's encounter against Brentford .
 OneFootball Videos
 And the Sussex outfit got off to the perfect start as Diego Gomez , who scored from the halfway line against Palace in October, rifled in another absolute cracker from 25 yards out.
 It was certainly a strike for the highlight reel and once again highlighted Brighton's knack for scoring long-range goals this season.
 8 - Brighton have scored eight goals from outside the box in all competitions this season, three more than any other Premier League side.
Thrillers.  –  Sunday, 8 November 2026 
 Diego Gómez's 100th shot for Brighton was a pretty special one.  –  Sunday, 8 November 2026 
 Brighton's chances of securing a seventh league win of the season improved further before half-time when Brentford's Igor Thiago was sent off for violent conduct.
